body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Firefly(www.fireflymobile.com) presented its mobile phone for kids 'flyphone' at the CES 2009.

The flyPhone is a multi-media cell phone with color screen that lets kids take pictures, record videos, listen to MP3's, play games, and send text messages. Built in parental controls allow parents to monitor usage and keep costs under control.

The flyPhone features a unique electro-luminescent morphing keypad that automatically switches between game controller, mp3 or video controller and number pad. Includes built-in games, ringtones, wallpapers and sample music and video for customization or use the included flyKicks PC software to create your own! Access the Firefly store for additional music, games, ringtones and wallpapers.
The flyPhone also includes PIN protected parental controls. Parents can chose to limit incoming and outgoing calls to numbers stored in the phone book while preventing additional numbers to be added.
